title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
subtitle: From India to the World — Humsafar Wedding FAQs for You

faqs.question: What is Humsafar Weddings, and what services do you offer?
faqs.answer: Humsafar Weddings is a premium wedding planning company that specializes in luxury destination weddings across India and abroad. We offer end-to-end services including wedding planning, theme décor, logistics, guest hospitality, entertainment, and complete on-ground execution.

faqs.question: Do you only plan destination weddings?
faqs.answer: Not at all. While destination weddings are our forte, we also curate luxury weddings in your hometown or any location of your choice with the same passion and precision.

faqs.question: Why choose Humsafar Weddings over other wedding planners?
faqs.answer: We focus on emotionally personalized, story-driven celebrations with world-class execution. From concept to coordination, our attention to detail, design innovation, and smooth management set us apart.

faqs.question: How far in advance should we start planning a destination wedding?
faqs.answer: We recommend starting at least 9 to 12 months in advance, especially for peak-season or international weddings. This ensures venue availability and a stress-free planning timeline.

faqs.question: Do you manage guest travel and accommodation?
list: 24x7 hospitality desk and concierge at the venue

faqs.question: How do you ensure a smooth wedding day experience?
faqs.answer: Our experienced on-ground team manages real-time vendor coordination, event flow, and guest support to ensure a flawless and enjoyable wedding experience for everyone.

faqs.question: Can you personalize our wedding to reflect our story and culture?
faqs.answer: Yes. We believe your wedding should reflect your story. We craft emotionally rich, culturally respectful celebrations with customized rituals, themes, and design elements.

faqs.question: What is the starting budget for a Humsafar Weddings event?
faqs.answer: Our weddings typically start from ₹70–80 lakhs and above, depending on location, guest count, scale, and level of customization.

faqs.question: Do you offer standard wedding planning packages?
faqs.answer: No. We believe every wedding is unique. Instead of fixed packages, we offer custom-tailored planning solutions based on your vision, preferences, and priorities.

faqs.question: How do we start planning our wedding with Humsafar?
faqs.answer_after: We'll schedule a complimentary wedding consultation to understand your requirements and share a tailored plan.

faqs.question: Is the first consultation chargeable?
faqs.answer: No. Your first consultation is completely free, with no obligation — just a heart-to-heart conversation about your story and vision.

faqs.question: What is your wedding planning payment structure?
faqs.answer: We follow a milestone-based payment model tied to project stages like concept design, vendor onboarding, and execution. This ensures transparency and builds trust every step of the way.
